items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb]: 'Contracts / CT-2026-0042' (aria-current). Header shows h1 title, 'Active' badge, subline 'CT-2026-0042 · Master service agreement · Northstar Technologies Ltd.', and a 4-field strip: value $240,000.00, period, owner, department.

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: One .btn.primary 'Edit contract' plus a '...' overflow (#moreMenu: Download summary, Copy record link, View history). Weakness: the primary is Edit rather than Renew, and no terminate action exists anywhere, but there is exactly one primary and the rest are secondary/overflow.

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: vendorPanel(): 'Emma Brooks' + 'Account director' + badge 'Primary'; href="mailto:emma.brooks@northstar.example", href="tel:+16175550142"; 'Daniel Kim' 'Billing & accounts' with mailto: and tel: links.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: paymentPanel(): columns Milestone, Due date, Status, Amount (USD); amount cell class 'num text-right' (tabular-nums) formatted with 2 decimals (60,000.00), currency in header and a total row with $ formatting; audit numericCells misaligned 0, nonTabular 0. Order: upcoming MS-04 (15 Dec) first, then paid. No overdue item exists in data.

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: Status badge text 'Upcoming' (neutral tone) vs 'Paid'; label is text, though it does not state days remaining and there is no 'Overdue' case handled in code.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: renewalPanel(): 'Renewal decision due' with 'Review by 16 Nov 2026 · in 11 days'; Expiry date '31 Dec 2026' also shown in terms. Remaining time is attached to the review deadline, not the expiry itself (no 'Expires in 56 days').

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: amendmentPanel() table: AMD-002 / 01 Oct 2026 / 'Add 24/7 priority incident support' / 'Waiting for Rachel Chen'; AMD-001 / 01 Jul 2026 / 'Expand coverage to the Austin office' / 'Rachel Chen · 24 Jun 2026'. Dates via date() as 'DD Mon YYYY'.

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: stateBody(entity,action) used by terms, payments, amendments, vendor, renewal, documents, activity: loading = skeleton rows with aria-label 'Loading ...' (and default state loading on first paint); error = 'Couldn't load ...' + button[data-retry] 'Retry'; empty = 'No ... yet.' + action button ('Add contact', 'Add milestone', 'Create amendment', 'Set up renewal'). Reachable via ?state=empty|error|loading.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: No terminate/cancel contract action or confirmation dialog exists in the markup or script (overflow menu has only Download summary, Copy record link, View history).

notes: Clean, restrained enterprise layout; audit score 100 with no violations. Initials avatars are used only for real people (SM, JL, EB, DK). The 4-field summary strip is a plain bordered row, not icon KPI tiles. Only real miss is the missing terminate flow; primary action is Edit rather than Renew; milestone 'Upcoming' label has no day count; no overdue milestone case in data.
